hooks.text: 最多四人共同管制同一空域，协作降低失误并冲击高分
hooks.excerpt: Each airport can accommodate up to 4 people online and supports the use of the Workshop map. You can work with your friends to jointly manage the same airspace to reduce the impact of mistakes and challenge higher scores!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每天结束后选择机场升级，逐步定制空域运行方式
hooks.excerpt: Every time you finish one day's management, you will be able to pick an upgrade for your airspace and airport: auto holding, accelerating turns, increasing airspace, waypoints ...... upgrade and customize airports to keep flights running more smoothly.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 特定地图会触发哈德逊迫降等航空史随机事件
hooks.excerpt: The game triggers random events under certain specific maps and conditions, featuring classic moments in aviation history: the miracle landing on the Hudson River, Air Force One crossing, emergency incidents, high-priority flights, etc.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
